original_question: For subcubic graphs, do the following stronger strong-edge-coloring bounds hold: first, if G is bridgeless and has more than 13 vertices, then chi_s(G) <= 8; second, if G has girth at least 5, then chi_s(G) <= 7?
target_in_paper: Section 4.2, Conjecture 32(b,c), restated in Section 6 as Open Problem 11.
correct_elements: Your draft correctly targets the paper’s two stronger conjectural upper bounds for the strong chromatic index of subcubic graphs: an 8-color bound under a bridgelessness-plus-size hypothesis, and a 7-color bound under a girth-at-least-5 hypothesis. It also correctly treats these as stronger refinements of earlier subcubic strong-edge-coloring conjectures discussed in the paper.
missing_details: The first bound in the paper is stated with |V(G)| >= 13, not 'more than 13 vertices'.
The paper phrases these as conjectural/open problems, not as established bounds.
The graph class should be stated explicitly: 'subcubic' means maximum degree at most 3.
The invariant should be named explicitly: chi'_s(G) is the strong chromatic index of G.
The two statements are bundled together in the paper as parts (b) and (c) of Conjecture 32.
The second statement has no additional bridgelessness assumption; it applies to every subcubic graph of girth at least 5.
If you want the question to be fully stand-alone, the notation |V(G)| and girth should be stated explicitly.
refined_question: Is the following two-part conjecture true? Let G be a subcubic graph, that is, a graph with maximum degree at most 3, and let chi'_s(G) denote the strong chromatic index of G. (i) If G is bridgeless and |V(G)| >= 13, then chi'_s(G) <= 8. (ii) If G has girth at least 5, then chi'_s(G) <= 7.
justification: The draft is essentially a near-paraphrase of the survey’s Conjecture 32(b,c) in Section 4.2, and the same pair of statements is repeated in Section 6 as Open Problem 11. The surrounding discussion in Section 4.2 makes clear that these are intended as stronger forms of earlier subcubic strong-edge-coloring conjectures: part (b) strengthens Conjecture 32(a), and part (c) strengthens Conjecture 31(e). The main correction needed is the vertex threshold: the paper says '|V(G)| >= 13', not 'more than 13 vertices'.
